notes.title: Save A Fox Pack | DLC
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly proud to share something close to our hearts: the [b]Save A Fox Pack[/b] is now available as DLC for [i]Spirit of the North 2[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3447cb76e88762c3a22e30714181a37756b6981f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This pack is a tribute to [b]Mikayla Raines[/b], the amazing founder of [b][url="https://www.saveafox.org/"]Save A Fox Rescue[/url][/b], who dedicated her life to rescuing and caring for captive-born foxes. If you’ve ever come across one of their videos online - a fox laughing, cuddling, or being cheeky - chances are, Mikayla made that moment possible.[/p][p]To honour her memory, we’ve worked closely with Save A Fox to create a special fox skins inspired by the beloved foxes: Finnegan, Fawzi & Ruby. We hope it brings a little extra magic and joy to your journey through the wild.

[b]All[/b] proceeds from this DLC go directly to Save A Fox Rescue, continuing Mikayla’s work and helping care for the foxes she loved so dearly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/07a3e64486c94dd3b69ea261e7ae8c473761b95d.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/722cb18e38277456e1c9d4725070bf071b3b8510.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]What’s in the Pack:[/b][/p][p]🦊 3 fox skins inspired by the adorable and spirited Finnegan, Fawzi & Ruby[/p][p]💫 The chance to support real-world fox rescue, just by playing  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/07a3e64486c94dd3b69ea261e7ae8c473761b95d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Mikayla’s kindness and strength reached far beyond the animals she saved. She built a community, inspired millions, and reminded us that every life - no matter how small or wild - is worth protecting.[/p][p]We hope this small tribute helps more people discover her mission and the wonderful work Save A Fox continues to do in her name.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/9e7b6fe8354013bbc505de8f917ffc0996a76c8a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are truly grateful for your kindness and continued support, not only for Spirit Of The North, but now also for Save A Fox and Mikayla's legacy.  [b]Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816570/Spirit_of_the_North_2_SaveAFox_Pack/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink][b] [/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #4 | Mikayla Memorial
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians,
[/h2][p]Today, we are introducing [b]Hotfix #4[/b]. which brings with it a number of improvements, patches & bug fixes, details of which you can find below. But above all, this update introduces something far more important and close to our hearts: a permanent in-game memorial to [b]Mikayla Raines[/b].
[/p][previewyoutube="vd15cduYUPY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Mikayla was the founder of [url="https://www.saveafox.org/"]SaveAFox Rescue,[/url] a passionate animal caretaker, and a gentle force for good in the lives of countless foxes, and people. We have had the opportunity to collaborate together on some upcoming news for Spirit Of The North 2, and we are fully committed to continue supporting SaveAFox in the coming months and years. We hope this memorial will be a place where you can peacefully, and respectfully remember Mikayla and her legacy.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][b]
A Place to Remember[/b][/h3][p]Nestled in a quiet corner of [b]Fox Village[/b], you will now find a new area dedicated to Mikayla’s memory. At its centre stands a newly-implemented mural of [b]Namara[/b], a character from the world of [i]Spirit of the North 2[/i] inspired by Mikayla herself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/c7fdb743fe62ca81281be7fc2d0de4154bd47313.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Namara’s name means [i]“No Sorrow”[/i] or [i]“The One Who Dispels Sorrow.”[/i] In the game’s lore, she was a gentle caretaker of animals whose home was a flourishing garden full of life - especially foxes. Her kindness, and deep compassion made her beloved by all creatures.[/p][p]You may also notice [b]Finnegan[/b], a small fox who hangs out near the mural, never straying far from Namara’s side. He is always there, resting by her side.[/p][p]Although we never knew Mikayla personally, this is how we choose to remember her: as someone who left beauty and joy in her wake. This memorial is our small way of honouring her. We hope it brings warmth to those who knew her, followed her, or were touched by her spirit.[/p][p]Thank you for sharing this world with us. And thank you, Mikayla, for helping make it kinder. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/8b53568c12ceeac13cac97e6c33f4ed82ac0fe76.jpg"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]SaveAFox tribute area added to Fox Island. [/p][h3]QOL UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Sprint Toggle[/b] can now be enabled in settings. notes.title: Hotfix #3 | Month 1 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians,[/h2][p]Thank you for you patience and ongoing feedback. We’ve been listening closely, reading every report, and working hard behind the scenes to deliver a more stable, immersive, and beautifully optimized experience. Today, we’re rolling out [b]Hotfix #3 the Month 1 Update[/b] - live now![/p][p][b]Here’s what’s included![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][/h3][h3]🔄 SAVE SYSTEM UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Backup Save System:[/b] The game now automatically creates a backup save every 25 minutes (max 10 backups). You can rollback to these if your main save is corrupted or soft-locked. Access this via Manage Save Data menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Game Naming:[/b] Simplified save file names (no special characters); Names are shorter to fix issues caused by file names becoming to long for some devices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Name Auditing:[/b] Long or invalid save names are now automatically corrected to conform to new system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Copy Fixes:[/b] Copying an original save multiple times during different play sessions no long causes new copies to overwrite existing copies. New save names are now unique.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Offline Achievements:[/b] Now properly tracked.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/09f2fbd6354ca8c9dda54f9492f31ff1ddeeb4a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]💆 QOL UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Keybinds on PC:[/b] "M" opens map, "Esc" opens Exit Menu. "Tab" still returns to your last visited tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Panning Map:[/b] Smoother and no longer clamped.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🕹️ GAMEPLAY & UI BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p][b]D-Pad Input Adjustments:[/b] D-pad up/down are no longer zooms the camera as these inputs are mapped to Fat Travel Home and Photomode. Zooming remains a PC-only feature (mouse wheel).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pressure Plate Fixes:[/b] Now reset properly if associated objects despawn or reset, fixing several soft-lock issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lava River Platforms:[/b] now spawn properly when you load game already in proximity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Destructible Ram Door:[/b] Now retains its broken state after being destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stormy Home Key Fix:[/b] No longer unlocked by unlocking Stormvale Portal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tomb of Heilda:[/b] Stone elevator fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ashlands Snake Shrine:[/b] puzzles fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Statue of Eona in Fox Island Cave:[/b] No longer overrides Home location when activated if main story is completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Waypoint Fix:[/b] Waypoints now correctly place on grave icons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scroll Pop-up:[/b] Scroll count display fixed.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 OPTIMIZATIONS[/h3][list][*][p][b]Reflection Quality Fix (Low Settings):[/b] PC visuals now look as intended. Low settings can now enjoy better visuals with no performance impact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjust World Position Offset Disable Distance[/b] 100s of game actors (Hazel Bushes, various plague meshes, flags, etc). These actors would invalidate shadow cache a extreme distances.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Static mobility[/b] now applied to non-moving components (chests base, door frames, standing stones, etc.). notes.title: Spirit Of The North 2 | What's Coming?
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians,
[/h2]

We just wanted to check in to let you know working hard behind the scenes.

There’s a lot currently in progress, and while not everything is ready to show just yet, we wanted to give you a quick peek behind the curtain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/6c84538dc5c18aa393530d8611f496aedc55a901.png[/img]
[h3]Backup Saves[/h3]
One of the bigger features we’re focused on right now is [b]backup saves[/b] - this will let players roll back their save file in case something goes wrong (power outages, etc.). It’s been a common request, and we're making good progress on it!

[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
The official stand-alone soundtrack is also coming together beautifully. It’s still [b]a few weeks [/b]out, but it’s getting close, and we think it’ll be [u]definitely[/u] worth the wait!

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
We’ve been working through many of environmental fixes: we're patching between [b]5 to 50 issues a day![/b] That includes miss aligned meshes, collision bugs, holes in map, etc.  Thank you for reporting these when you find them! 

We’re also adding [b]key binds[/b] for specific menu tabs, like pressing [b]“M”[/b] to open the map directly. This was one of the most requested features, and we’re happy to be implementing it.

There is a bug that disable reflections when the player uses Low Settings.  It honestly looks horrendous and was not intended.  If you've been playing and everything has a strange white glossiness to it, this is why.  We've fixed it and it is queued for the next update.  This will make LOW quality look like a [b]100x better[/b] in many situations. 

[b]Low Settings - Before (with Reflection Bug)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/6ab7859cf0ce31d67f3b40fb5cfc0670935ed754.jpg[/img]

[b]Low Settings - After (as intended)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/ba551ccf71bb7d9f7c063bce38224befe06a2c83.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

We’re a small team, and every bit of feedback, encouragement, and patience from all of you truly means the world to us. Your support helps keep us going: it’s what makes this journey worthwhile. [b]Thank you for being here and for believing in what we’re creating.[/b]

More concrete updates are coming soon, and we can’t wait to share more when the time is right.

[b]Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix #2 | Week 2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Guardians! 🦊 [/h2]

We’re excited to share that Hotfix #1.3, CL 12895, now live on PC, with the console update arriving in just a few days! This patch brings a host of important fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and community-requested changes. Let’s dive in:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]
[h3]🔧List of fixes[/h3]
[*] Collection Removed At End Of Game.  Fixed issue that caused players to lose their collection(Relics and Keys) after finishing game if they died before reaching a Statue of Eona.
[*]Save Game Repair. We implemented a script that audits and repairs your save file that runs automatically when you select a save game to play.  Currently this includes fixes for those who's Relics and Keys were deleted at the end of their game. The game will re-add them when you relaunch your save game. This script also attempts to re-add your Raven companion if you have a Glide Rune but no Raven.
[*]Landscape and Cliff meshing around Misthaven Northern gate.  Waterfall and pond added to prevent players from accessing Highlands with a torch.
[*]Jump Gate in North Misthaven now uses standing stone for activation(requires spirit form). 
[*]Stag Temple now traps player inside to force them to use Spirit Form.  Many players were obtaining Spirit Form and just leaving. 
[*]Progress Lost issue #1.  The Ram Encounter would continue to block autosave if the player abandoned it.  This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
[*]Progress Lost issues #2.  Some puzzle involving hiding wisps and cutscenes would not stop blocking autosaves. This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
[*]Removed rogue lever in front of Bear Guardian Temple.
[*]Various fixes to Fox Island behavior and appearance when returning after end of game. ie Killbox under wooden bridge will not be present. Also plugged hole leading to portion of cave that is intended to be inaccessible.
[*]Lighting changes for Lumen on Xbox Series S
[*]Mosswood Foliage Cleanup.
[*]Added ext triggers for some Stormvale structures.
[*]Internet Time Events now uses our own website.  This should fix the issue of events like the Light Weaver not being blocked in countries like Russia. We will continue to test and work on this and thank you for you ongoing patience.
[*]Added Bear Roar SFX to end encounter.
[*]Added missing lava SFX
[*]Misc fixes for environment holes and and misaligned meshes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support for our small team. Your reports and suggestions help make Spirit Of The North 2 the best it can be. As always, we’ll be keeping an eye out for your thoughts and suggestions!


[b]Infuse Studio & The Silver Lining Interactive Team[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Guardians! [/h2]

Thank you so much for all the support and kindness you've shown our small team in the first week of our game's launch - we're overwhelmed with the amount of support! You've been incredibly helpful by sharing the bugs and issues you've encountered. 

There are still issues to address and it's likely others will pop up, the five of us are quickly looking to address what we can by importance and volume and we've been hard at work implementing a number of fixes to issues you, our community highlighted. These include;

[h3]Gameplay changes & fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've added a Wisp after the glide cavern, to help guide the player towards Mosswood
[*] In the Sunfire passage, the door that requires pressure plates, now requires rope pulls to open it, allowing players to backtrack if they want
[*] The Raven logic has been updated. Now, Thought the Raven will return to you even if you choose not to follow her directions
[*] Murals now ignite regardless of Thought being with you or not. Now murals will always be lit, so you don't miss then on the change Thought has gone on her own little adventure..
[*] Tweaks to the Sunfire passage to make the area more consistent and streamlined
[*] The Guardian Intro Cutscenes now only play once per gameplay session
[*] Added an additional condition for Thought joining you, fixing for players who managed to miss her
[*] Dropped Items now disappear after 3 minutes instead of 2
[*] The Raccoon Cleanup Crew will hold items for a full 10 seconds before taking it (instead of 5), giving the player more time to react
[*] Bite damage is no longer prevented by equipping the Thorn Walker Rune
[*] Wisp form can no longer be used to bypass the Sea Monster, AKA Gerald
[*] Wisp form can no longer be used to prevent damage to fox body
[*] Fixes to Ashlands Snake Shrine puzzle making it more consistent

[/list]

[h3]Environment changes & fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed trap holes in Stormvale Tower that players can fall down and get stuck inside
[*] Ashland Racoon Grotto collision bug fixes
[*] Fox Island foliage bug fixes
[*] Raven Temple trap holes collision fixes
[*] Sign posts added before and after glide cavern to help guide player
[*] Tree trunk collisions updated, so foxes are no longer stuck in trees..
[*] Stormvale cliff meshing around Ram Temple updated to keep players from climbing up to the top before returning the Relics
[*] We've added numerous blockers for player graves in dungeons, so that the graves will no longer spawn at the bottom of inaccessible pits and instead, close to the last spot they fell from
[*] Performance Issues near player home mirrors fixed
[*] Forest Tower collision fixes
[*] Blockers added to Misthaven to keep players from leaving before cleansing Memory
[/list]


[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-exported Major Guardian cutscenes in better quality
[*] Added a new sound effects to 'evil' associated puzzles
[*] Fix for Final guardian pre-fight music not triggering
[*] Fix for Fox vocalizations not playing in corrupted zones
[*] Further memory optimization, more music now streams
[*] Added Tribe layer of audio to Raven Temple and Seer’s Crypt
[*] Added SFX to burning trees in Ashland
[*] Added Vista music changes
[*] Added Puzzle Complete sound effects to all Biomes
[*] Guardian 3&4 Cutscene audio now plays correctly on multiple encounter attempts
[*] Glacier music now plays correctly
[*] Glacier sound effects tweaks
[*] Added Glide sound effects
[*] Whimper SFXs tweaked
[*] Added Outro for final guardian Encounter
[*] Added SFX to a phase of the final guardian  Encounter
[/list]

[h3]Console Specific[/h3]
*Console fixes will go live in the next 10 working days.
Global Illumination issues have been addressed, resolving excessive darkness in underground areas. Lighting quality in these areas is now comparable to the PC version
Fixed camera jitter. Camera movement over uneven surfaces/collisions now matches PC behaviour

[/url]

notes.title: Spirit of the North 2 Development Update.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello folks,[/h1]

Spirit of the North 2 is mere days away and we’re beyond excited for you to immerse yourselves in this atmospheric adventure about Fox and their Raven companion. As we near ever closer to SOTN2’s release we wanted to address the experiences many of you had with the demo that was released last year. 

First off, we want to say a genuine and heartfelt thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and critiques. Not only was the feedback valid and invaluable, the sheer volume of separate Discussion threads and associated comments reiterated to us how much love you all have for our game and your anticipation for the next instalment. 

While we didn’t respond to you all directly, the Infuse team did write about the SOTN 2’s demo, optimization, origins, impacts of using UE5 during its Beta phase while simultaneously developing a new game and the goals for SOTN 2 as a whole. All of which you can read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1778840/discussions/0/4696783943311038989/]here[/url].

To continue with our goal of transparent communication we want to give you more information and context about what the team at Infuse have been working on since the SOTN 2 demo originally launched and how this work will prevent many of the challenges you experienced in the demo happening in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/e557538e3ca3b72e0465752ae35809e06a91b284.jpg[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The last months of 2024 were spent [i][u]solely [/u][/i]on optimisation. Everything from weather, the in-game day/night cycle to UI and menu performance, has all been looked at to try and squeeze every last frame out of the game to make it as smooth an experience as possible. 

[h2]Onboarding[/h2]
There have been changes to the opening portions of the game when it comes to player onboarding. As a semi open world game with vast areas to explore, it was important to find the right balance between not showing players a dotted path in front to follow whilst also not making them feel lost with no sense of direction.
 
With the help of things like Red Smoke trails guiding players to all major dungeon locations ([i]a feature call-back to the original Spirit of the North[/i]), you are able to explore the beauty and wonder of the world until your hearts content knowing that all you need to do is look for these Red Smoke Trails to instantly get back on track. This, along with other tweaks in the opening level have been designed specifically to show mini examples of SOTN 2’s gameplay loop players will experience once they are let loose into the world.

[h2]Story and Cutscenes[/h2]
It's important to make players care about the journey they are undertaking and to care about the relationship between the fox and the raven as you help each other navigate a vast world. By far the most important way is to finalise and add in fully rendered in-engine cutscenes as well as beautifully hand drawn ones that appear during each Guardian encounter.

[h2][i]More [/i]Optimisation![/h2]
More recently we have done extensive compatibility testing to try and make sure we can recommend the minimum and also best suited specs for the game. As an Unreal Engine 5 title, it will need a powerful rig to see it in all its beauty but we've tried to make it as accessible as possible to players that don't have super up to date machines. There are extensive settings to tweak to your liking and even on low settings, still is a sight to behold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/bd91cdc97198522f9525b8cc7227dac15c3d79e9.jpg[/img]

We understand that everyone may not have access to the hardware required to run this game. The minimum and recommended specifications are listed on SOTN 2’s store page and we’ve also included them below. We want to ensure as much as possible that everyone can make as much of an informed decision as possible when it comes to purchasing our game.

[h2]Minimum:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
[*] OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
[*] Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / Radeon RX 6800
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 25 GB available space
[/list]
[b]Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 30, Graphics Setting Preset: Low[/b]

[h2]Recommended:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
[*] OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
[*] Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / Radeon RX 7800 XT
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 25 GB available space
[/list]
[b]Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 60, Graphics Setting Preset: High[/b]

We hope this information and context gives you some assurance to the quality of the game we’re making. Thank you so much to our community, old and new, for the level of support you’ve shown the developers, Infuse Studio and Spirit of the North 1 & 2. We’re humbled by your support. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/

See you in the wilderness!
Silver Lining Int and Infuse Studio

notes.title: Developer Diary #1 - World Introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/9872151248fcbfe2297c56395551a2a85e4b1822.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

We're going to kick off a series of dev blog updates to give you more insight into the world of Spirit of the North and give some sneak peeks into what you'll have in store on the epic journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

[h2]The Fox[/h2]
In Spirit of the North 2, you step into the paws of an entirely new fox from the protagonist of the first game. Taking in feedback from the first game, the fox character has been completely rebuilt from the ground up, with an updated look and a newly designed movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/131edca9237156390eb7e7364f90f9127e10aa2c.png[/img]

[h2]The Raven[/h2]
Joining you for this adventure is your new companion, Thought, a wise Raven who will help guide you on your journey and aid you in traversing this new world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/ea2652003144c884dd64cbdcda41596141e5bab7.jpg[/img]

[h2]The World[/h2]
Those who played the original Spirit of the North will be familiar with the icy Nordic-inspired landscapes they had to navigate. For Spirit of the North 2, we're going much bigger with the game world and sending players off to discover a variety of different regions, each with its own flavor featuring unique weather patterns. 

Additionally, the move to Unreal Engine 5 has given us a range of tools to enhance the handcrafted world, bringing more detailed lighting and effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/56252e2987d957e99c361b1688351b84c7dea136.png[/img]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]
Players will discover runes along the journey that they can equip to change appearance and grant them abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/5e0234ad3822b31ed613eafd216265a037e2b491.jpg[/img]

[h2]Music[/h2]
It wouldn't be a SOTN game without emotionally stirring music and immersive sound effects. This has been a major focus and our composer has truly elevated the experience of exploring the various landscapes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/7fb374cfe2259628fffbe27e6823f86b52b22975.jpg[/img]

We are excited for you to experience the beautiful journey of Spirit of the North 2.
Stay tuned for more updates from us over the upcoming months!
